---
title: "Stage 3d: Sample construction – Model A and Model B (agency-city)"
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Build the Model A and Model B analytical samples at the agency-city
#           level (HQ-anchored / restricted / extended-coverage variants).
# Inputs  : data/cleaned/recalls_clean.rds
#           data/cleaned/ntd_transit.rds
#           data/cleaned/roster_ntd.rds  (city_id, ntd_id, match flags)
# Outputs : data/cleaned/sample_modelA_pairs.rds  (one row per qualifying pair)
#           data/cleaned/sample_modelB_pairs.rds
# =============================================================================
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")

recalls <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "recalls_clean.rds"))
ntd     <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "ntd_transit.rds"))
ntd_ros <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "roster_ntd.rds")) |>
  mutate(match_via_rest = match_via_hq &
                          (match_via_sa_place | match_via_sa_county))

WINDOW <- 2014:2024

# Pre-aggregate NTD to (agency, year), restricted to positive capital obs.
ntd_obs <- ntd |>
  filter(!is.na(total_capital_usd), total_capital_usd > 0,
         year %in% WINDOW) |>
  distinct(ntd_id, year)

cat("NTD agency-year obs in window:", nrow(ntd_obs), "across",
    n_distinct(ntd_obs$ntd_id), "agencies\n")
cat("Roster pairs:", nrow(ntd_ros),
    "(", n_distinct(ntd_ros$city_id), "cities,",
    n_distinct(ntd_ros$ntd_id), "agencies)\n")
```

## Universe

```{r}
#| label: universe
universe_events  <- recalls
universe_cities  <- recalls |> distinct(city_id)

cat("=== UNIVERSE (recall-active cities, 2014-2024) ===\n")
cat("Petition events:", nrow(universe_events), "\n")
cat("Unique cities:  ", nrow(universe_cities), "\n")
```

## Model A – successful recall as treatment

```{r}
#| label: model-A-treated-cities
# Treatment: Removed | Resigned
A2_events <- universe_events |>
  filter(any_removed | any_resigned) |>
  mutate(outcome_cat = case_when(
    any_removed  ~ "Removed",
    any_resigned ~ "Resigned"
  ))
A2_cities <- A2_events |> distinct(city_id)

# Anchor year for each treated city (first successful recall, for cities w/ multiple)
treat_anchor <- A2_events |>
  group_by(city_id) |>
  summarise(treat_year = min(filing_year), .groups = "drop")

cat("Successful-recall (treated) cities:", nrow(A2_cities), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-A-pair-classification
# Build full set of (treated city, matched agency) pairs, with agency NTD coverage.
# Then check the pre/post requirement per (matching tier, city).

# All treated city -> agency pairs (any match method) with each agency's
# NTD coverage years.
pair_cov <- treat_anchor |>
  inner_join(ntd_ros, by = "city_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  left_join(ntd_obs, by = "ntd_id", relationship = "many-to-many")

# Per city, aggregate pre/post obs counts for each matching tier in a single pass.
# Tiers are nested: rest ⊆ hq ⊆ ext. Qualifying = >=1 pre and >=1 post obs.
city_cov <- pair_cov |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  group_by(city_id, treat_year) |>
  summarise(n_pre_hq    = sum(year <  treat_year & match_via_hq),
            n_post_hq   = sum(year >= treat_year & match_via_hq),
            n_pre_rest  = sum(year <  treat_year & match_via_rest),
            n_post_rest = sum(year >= treat_year & match_via_rest),
            n_pre_ext   = sum(year <  treat_year),
            n_post_ext  = sum(year >= treat_year),
            .groups = "drop")

A_treated_hq   <- city_cov |> filter(n_pre_hq   >= 1, n_post_hq   >= 1) |> pull(city_id)
A_treated_rest <- city_cov |> filter(n_pre_rest >= 1, n_post_rest >= 1) |> pull(city_id)
A_treated_ext  <- city_cov |> filter(n_pre_ext  >= 1, n_post_ext  >= 1) |> pull(city_id)

cat("Treated cities qualifying under HQ-anchored pre/post:    ", length(A_treated_hq), "\n")
cat("Treated cities qualifying under restricted pre/post:     ", length(A_treated_rest), "\n")
cat("Treated cities qualifying under extended-coverage pre/post:", length(A_treated_ext), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-A-control-pool
# Control pool = recall-active cities WITHOUT a successful recall, that have any
# matched agency with any obs in the window.
ctrl_universe <- universe_cities |> anti_join(A2_cities, by = "city_id")

# Per (city, tier), does any matched agency have any obs in the window?
ctrl_cov <- ctrl_universe |>
  inner_join(ntd_ros, by = "city_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  inner_join(ntd_obs, by = "ntd_id", relationship = "many-to-many")

A_control_hq   <- ctrl_cov |> filter(match_via_hq)   |> distinct(city_id) |> pull(city_id)
A_control_rest <- ctrl_cov |> filter(match_via_rest) |> distinct(city_id) |> pull(city_id)
A_control_ext  <- ctrl_cov |> distinct(city_id) |> pull(city_id)

cat("Control cities qualifying under HQ-anchored tier:    ", length(A_control_hq), "\n")
cat("Control cities qualifying under restricted tier:     ", length(A_control_rest), "\n")
cat("Control cities qualifying under extended-coverage tier:", length(A_control_ext), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-A-pairs-build
# Build the (city, agency) pair table for Model A.
# A pair is in_modelA_hq if:
#   (a) the agency's match_via_hq is TRUE for that city, AND
#   (b) the city is in A_treated_hq OR A_control_hq
# A pair is in_modelA_ext if:
#   (a) the pair is in the roster (any match method), AND
#   (b) the city is in A_treated_ext OR A_control_ext

A_pairs <- ntd_ros |>
  semi_join(bind_rows(A2_cities, ctrl_universe), by = "city_id") |>
  mutate(
    group_A = case_when(
      city_id %in% A2_cities$city_id ~ "treated",
      TRUE                            ~ "control"
    ),
    in_modelA_hq = match_via_hq &
      ((group_A == "treated" & city_id %in% A_treated_hq) |
       (group_A == "control" & city_id %in% A_control_hq)),
    in_modelA_rest = match_via_rest &
      ((group_A == "treated" & city_id %in% A_treated_rest) |
       (group_A == "control" & city_id %in% A_control_rest)),
    in_modelA_ext =
      ((group_A == "treated" & city_id %in% A_treated_ext) |
       (group_A == "control" & city_id %in% A_control_ext))
  )

stopifnot(all(A_pairs$in_modelA_hq   <= A_pairs$match_via_hq))
stopifnot(all(A_pairs$in_modelA_rest <= A_pairs$match_via_rest))
stopifnot(all(A_pairs$in_modelA_rest <= A_pairs$in_modelA_hq))

cat("\n=== MODEL A PAIRS ===\n")
cat("Roster pairs touching Model A universe:", nrow(A_pairs), "\n")
for (flag in c("in_modelA_hq", "in_modelA_rest", "in_modelA_ext")) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-16s pairs: %d  (treated=%d, control=%d)\n",
              flag, sum(A_pairs[[flag]]),
              sum(A_pairs[[flag]] & A_pairs$group_A == "treated"),
              sum(A_pairs[[flag]] & A_pairs$group_A == "control")))
}

cat("\nDistinct cities by sample:\n")
for (flag in c("in_modelA_hq", "in_modelA_rest", "in_modelA_ext")) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-16s treated=%d  control=%d\n", flag,
              n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs[[flag]] & A_pairs$group_A == "treated"]),
              n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs[[flag]] & A_pairs$group_A == "control"])))
}
```

## Model B – petition filing as treatment

```{r}
#| label: model-B-pair-classification
# Petition timing per city
city_petitions <- universe_events |>
  group_by(city_id) |>
  summarise(first_pet = min(filing_year),
            last_pet  = max(filing_year),
            .groups = "drop")

# (city, agency) coverage relative to petition windows, by matching tier
B_pair_cov <- city_petitions |>
  inner_join(ntd_ros, by = "city_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  left_join(ntd_obs,  by = "ntd_id", relationship = "many-to-many")

B_city_cov <- B_pair_cov |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  group_by(city_id, first_pet, last_pet) |>
  summarise(n_pre_hq    = sum(year <  first_pet & match_via_hq),
            n_post_hq   = sum(year >= last_pet  & match_via_hq),
            n_pre_rest  = sum(year <  first_pet & match_via_rest),
            n_post_rest = sum(year >= last_pet  & match_via_rest),
            n_pre_ext   = sum(year <  first_pet),
            n_post_ext  = sum(year >= last_pet),
            .groups = "drop")

B_cities_hq   <- B_city_cov |> filter(n_pre_hq   >= 1, n_post_hq   >= 1) |> pull(city_id)
B_cities_rest <- B_city_cov |> filter(n_pre_rest >= 1, n_post_rest >= 1) |> pull(city_id)
B_cities_ext  <- B_city_cov |> filter(n_pre_ext  >= 1, n_post_ext  >= 1) |> pull(city_id)

cat("Model B cities qualifying under HQ-anchored tier:    ", length(B_cities_hq), "\n")
cat("Model B cities qualifying under restricted tier:     ", length(B_cities_rest), "\n")
cat("Model B cities qualifying under extended-coverage tier:", length(B_cities_ext), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: model-B-pairs-build
B_pairs <- ntd_ros |>
  semi_join(universe_cities, by = "city_id") |>
  mutate(
    in_modelB_hq   = match_via_hq   & city_id %in% B_cities_hq,
    in_modelB_rest = match_via_rest & city_id %in% B_cities_rest,
    in_modelB_ext  = city_id %in% B_cities_ext
  )

stopifnot(all(B_pairs$in_modelB_hq   <= B_pairs$match_via_hq))
stopifnot(all(B_pairs$in_modelB_rest <= B_pairs$match_via_rest))
stopifnot(all(B_pairs$in_modelB_rest <= B_pairs$in_modelB_hq))

cat("\n=== MODEL B PAIRS ===\n")
for (flag in c("in_modelB_hq", "in_modelB_rest", "in_modelB_ext")) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-16s pairs: %d  (%d cities)\n",
              flag, sum(B_pairs[[flag]]),
              n_distinct(B_pairs$city_id[B_pairs[[flag]]])))
}
```

## Save artifacts

```{r}
#| label: save
# Add city-level attributes to carry into the panel.
A_pairs_save <- A_pairs |>
  left_join(treat_anchor |> rename(first_success_year = treat_year),
            by = "city_id") |>
  left_join(A2_events |> distinct(city_id, outcome_cat) |>
              group_by(city_id) |>
              summarise(outcome_cat = paste(sort(unique(outcome_cat)), collapse=";"),
                        .groups="drop"),
            by = "city_id")

saveRDS(A_pairs_save, here("data", "cleaned", "sample_modelA_pairs.rds"))
saveRDS(B_pairs,      here("data", "cleaned", "sample_modelB_pairs.rds"))

cat("Saved sample artifacts:\n")
cat("  sample_modelA_pairs.rds:", nrow(A_pairs_save), "pairs\n")
cat("  sample_modelB_pairs.rds:", nrow(B_pairs), "pairs\n")
```

## Exit criteria

```{r}
#| label: exit
n_treated_hq   <- n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs$in_modelA_hq   & A_pairs$group_A == "treated"])
n_control_hq   <- n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs$in_modelA_hq   & A_pairs$group_A == "control"])
n_treated_rest <- n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs$in_modelA_rest & A_pairs$group_A == "treated"])
n_control_rest <- n_distinct(A_pairs$city_id[A_pairs$in_modelA_rest & A_pairs$group_A == "control"])
n_B_hq         <- n_distinct(B_pairs$city_id[B_pairs$in_modelB_hq])
n_B_rest       <- n_distinct(B_pairs$city_id[B_pairs$in_modelB_rest])

cat(sprintf("- Model A HQ treated >=5 and HQ control >=20:    %s (%d, %d)\n",
            n_treated_hq >= 5 && n_control_hq >= 20, n_treated_hq, n_control_hq))
cat(sprintf("- Model A restricted treated >=1 and control >=1: %s (%d, %d)\n",
            n_treated_rest >= 1 && n_control_rest >= 1, n_treated_rest, n_control_rest))
cat(sprintf("- Model B HQ pre/post-observable >=30:           %s (%d)\n",
            n_B_hq >= 30, n_B_hq))
cat(sprintf("- Model B restricted pre/post-observable >=10:   %s (%d)\n",
            n_B_rest >= 10, n_B_rest))
```
